capability_leases_scope_check.name: capability_leases_scope_check
capability_leases_scope_check.value: ("capability_leases"."scope_kind" = 'account' AND "capability_leases"."project_id" IS NULL) OR ("capability_leases"."scope_kind" = 'project' AND "capability_leases"."project_id" IS NOT NULL)

capability_leases_state_check.name: capability_leases_state_check
capability_leases_state_check.value: ("capability_leases"."status" = 'active' AND "capability_leases"."remaining_uses" > 0 AND "capability_leases"."revoked_at" IS NULL) OR ("capability_leases"."status" = 'revoked' AND "capability_leases"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("capability_leases"."status" = 'depleted' AND "capability_leases"."remaining_uses" = 0 AND "capability_leases"."revoked_at" IS NULL)

data_subject_events_evidence_hash_check.name: data_subject_events_evidence_hash_check
data_subject_events_evidence_hash_check.value: "data_subject_events"."evidence_sha256" IS NULL OR (length("data_subject_events"."evidence_sha256") = 64 AND "data_subject_events"."evidence_sha256" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

data_subject_requests_counts_check.name: data_subject_requests_counts_check
data_subject_requests_counts_check.value: ("data_subject_requests"."dataset_count" IS NULL OR "data_subject_requests"."dataset_count" >= 0) AND ("data_subject_requests"."row_count" IS NULL OR "data_subject_requests"."row_count" >= 0)

data_subject_requests_manifest_hash_chec.name: data_subject_requests_manifest_hash_check
data_subject_requests_manifest_hash_chec.value: "data_subject_requests"."manifest_sha256" IS NULL OR (length("data_subject_requests"."manifest_sha256") = 64 AND "data_subject_requests"."manifest_sha256" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

data_subject_requests_payload_hash_check.name: data_subject_requests_payload_hash_check
data_subject_requests_payload_hash_check.value: "data_subject_requests"."payload_sha256" IS NULL OR (length("data_subject_requests"."payload_sha256") = 64 AND "data_subject_requests"."payload_sha256" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

data_subject_requests_confirmation_hash_.name: data_subject_requests_confirmation_hash_check
data_subject_requests_confirmation_hash_.value: "data_subject_requests"."confirmation_sha256" IS NULL OR (length("data_subject_requests"."confirmation_sha256") = 64 AND "data_subject_requests"."confirmation_sha256" NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*')

data_subject_requests_export_state_check.name: data_subject_requests_export_state_check
data_subject_requests_export_state_check.value: "data_subject_requests"."request_type" <> 'export' OR ("data_subject_requests"."status" = 'completed' AND "data_subject_requests"."manifest_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "data_subject_requests"."payload_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "data_subject_requests"."dataset_count" IS NOT NULL AND "data_subject_requests"."row_count" IS NOT NULL AND "data_subject_requests"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "data_subject_requests"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)

data_subject_requests_deletion_state_che.name: data_subject_requests_deletion_state_check
data_subject_requests_deletion_state_che.value: "data_subject_requests"."request_type" <> 'deletion' OR ("data_subject_requests"."status" = 'requested' AND "data_subject_requests"."confirmation_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "data_subject_requests"."confirmation_hint" IS NOT NULL AND "data_subject_requests"."confirm_by" IS NOT NULL AND "data_subject_requests"."execute_after" IS NULL AND "data_subject_requests"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "data_subject_requests"."cancelled_at" IS NULL) OR ("data_subject_requests"."status" IN ('scheduled', 'executing') AND "data_subject_requests"."confirmation_sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "data_subject_requests"."confirmation_hint" IS NOT NULL AND "data_subject_requests"."confirm_by" IS NOT NULL AND "data_subject_requests"."execute_after" IS NOT NULL AND "data_subject_requests"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "data_subject_requests"."cancelled_at" IS NULL) OR ("data_subject_requests"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "data_subject_requests"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "data_subject_requests"."completed_at" IS NULL) OR ("data_subject_requests"."status" = 'failed' AND "data_subject_requests"."completed_at" IS NULL)

memory_entries_scope_check.name: memory_entries_scope_check
memory_entries_scope_check.value: ("memory_entries"."scope_kind" = 'account' AND "memory_entries"."project_id" IS NULL) OR ("memory_entries"."scope_kind" = 'project' AND "memory_entries"."project_id" IS NOT NULL)

tool_execution_leases_scope_check.name: tool_execution_leases_scope_check
tool_execution_leases_scope_check.value: ("tool_execution_leases"."scope_kind" = 'account' AND "tool_execution_leases"."project_id" IS NULL) OR ("tool_execution_leases"."scope_kind" = 'project' AND "tool_execution_leases"."project_id" IS NOT NULL)

tool_execution_leases_state_check.name: tool_execution_leases_state_check
tool_execution_leases_state_check.value: ("tool_execution_leases"."status" = 'active' AND "tool_execution_leases"."remaining_uses" > 0 AND "tool_execution_leases"."revoked_at" IS NULL) OR ("tool_execution_leases"."status" = 'revoked' AND "tool_execution_leases"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("tool_execution_leases"."status" = 'depleted' AND "tool_execution_leases"."remaining_uses" = 0 AND "tool_execution_leases"."revoked_at" IS NULL)

tool_jobs_output_size_check.name: tool_jobs_output_size_check
tool_jobs_output_size_check.value: "tool_jobs"."output_json" IS NULL OR length(CAST("tool_jobs"."output_json" AS BLOB)) <= 48000

tool_jobs_worker_claim_check.name: tool_jobs_worker_claim_check
tool_jobs_worker_claim_check.value: ("tool_jobs"."worker_id" IS NULL AND "tool_jobs"."claim_expires_at" IS NULL) OR ("tool_jobs"."worker_id" IS NOT NULL AND "tool_jobs"."claim_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

worker_agents_state_check.name: worker_agents_state_check
worker_agents_state_check.value: ("worker_agents"."status" IN ('active', 'draining') AND "worker_agents"."revoked_at" IS NULL) OR ("worker_agents"."status" = 'revoked' AND "worker_agents"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL)
